name: heavy_transport_dmix_oracle_ne_sensitivity
claim: For two electron-density states, production qpx-opt D_mix values for all seven oxygen heavy species agree with an independent mixture-averaged diffusion oracle within 2e-5 relative; neutral D_mix is ne-invariant and charged D_mix demonstrates dynamic Debye-Huckel ne sensitivity.
fail_class: oracle/parity/resolver/dynamic-screening/runtime; pre-physics P0-P2 failures are construction/harness/data failures, not physics failures
